case_title: SAN FRANCISCO CITY EMPLOYEES CREDIT UNION VS RANDALL HENRY

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $447.50 FILED BY SAN FRANCISCO CITY EMPLOYEES CREDIT UNION AS TO DEFENDANT RANDALL HENRY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-23-1991 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 04

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SAN FRANCISCO CITY EMPLOYEES CREDIT UNION RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RANDALL HENRY $415.00 PRINCIPAL, $36.50 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $451.50 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
